To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of contextual features increases the accuracy of the emotion detection task.

1) augmenting standard lexical features with contextual features derived from the dialog structure increases classification accuracy by up to 2.6%; 2) augmenting standard prosodic features with the contextual features derived from prosodic features also increases classification accuracy by about 2.6%, and; 3) the best results are achieved using a combination of lexical and prosodic contextual features.

(1) augmenting standard features with contextual features increases accuracy by 2%, and (2) augmenting standard prosodic features with prosodic features extracted from the current turn and the previous turns increases accuracy by 1%.
